Unclear whether dialogue_03629-03630 are both Berkt (register shift) or an unnamed speaker responding to the 'Can you hear me, Berkt!?' callout at dialogue_03628 (previous slice). No pronoun choice was required in English either way, so nothing was asserted.

This argument is not speaker-tagged. The condescending replies (dialogue_03637, 03639, 03643, 03645) are read as Berkt on voice/personality match with his glossary profile ('reserved, emotionally guarded; hostile toward Barrel'); the accusing lines are read as an ally, plausibly Barrel given the 'people you want to protect' theme echoed later at dialogue_03679. No name was written into any of these targets.

Heero's mid-battle arrival and Berkt's taunting withdrawal are told through untagged lines. dialogue_03660, 03661, 03664 and 03665 are read as Berkt (condescension, then a chilling remark about not letting the opponent die easily) on tone, not an explicit tag.
